title: Grade 4 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Termly Exam #4 (Term 1)

pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #4 (TERM 1)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which surah teaches us to thank Allah and stay humble when we succeed? (1 mark)
   A. Al-Falaq
   B. Al-Masad
   C. Al-Kafirun
   D. An-Nasr

2. The two surahs of seeking refuge are (1 mark)
   A. Al-Fatiha and Al-Ikhlas
   B. Al-Kafirun and Al-Fatiha
   C. Al-Masad and An-Nasr
   D. Al-Falaq and An-Naas

3. Which surah contains the words "You have your religion and I have mine"? (1 mark)
   A. Al-Kafirun
   B. An-Nasr
   C. Al-Masad
   D. Al-Ikhlas

4. The name Al-Fatiha means (1 mark)
   A. The Cow
   B. The Victory
   C. The Sincerity
   D. The Opening

5. Which surah is number 110 in the Qur'an? (1 mark)
   A. Al-Kafirun
   B. Al-Ikhlas
   C. An-Nasr
   D. Al-Masad

6. Who took care of the Prophet after his mother died and his grandfather passed on? (1 mark)
   A. Ali as a baby
   B. His uncle Abu Talib
   C. Abu Bakr
   D. Waraqa

7. Zawadi prays on time but shouts at her brother. What is wrong? (1 mark)
   A. Prayer is wrong
   B. Nothing is wrong
   C. Good prayer should go with good manners
   D. Shouting is a Sunnah

8. When eating with others from one dish, what should you do? (1 mark)
   A. Eat from your own side of the dish
   B. Take the whole dish
   C. Reach across for the best piece
   D. Push others

9. How should we treat a guest at the meal? (1 mark)
   A. Give them the smallest share
   B. Ignore them
   C. Serve them first and respect them
   D. Eat quickly before them

10. Which habit protects teeth? (1 mark)
   A. Never rinsing
   B. Eating sweets all day
   C. Sharing toothbrushes
   D. Brushing twice a day

11. According to the syllabus hadith, brushing teeth is a means of (1 mark)
   A. Making teeth white only
   B. Gaining money
   C. Avoiding prayer
   D. Purifying the mouth and pleasing Allah

12. Which value is learned from team games? (1 mark)
   A. Teamwork
   B. Selfishness
   C. Pride
   D. Cheating

13. Which three skills are named in the syllabus hadith? (1 mark)
   A. Cooking, sewing and farming
   B. Reading, writing and drawing
   C. Swimming, archery and horse riding
   D. Driving, typing and singing

14. Which name teaches that Allah owns everything we have? (1 mark)
   A. Ar-Rahim
   B. Al-Malik
   C. As-Sami'
   D. As-Salam

15. What does "As-Salam" mean? (1 mark)
   A. The Most Merciful
   B. The Source of Peace
   C. The King
   D. The All-Hearing

16. Why should belief in Raqib and Atid help us behave well? (1 mark)
   A. They punish us at once
   B. Our words and actions are recorded
   C. They laugh at us
   D. They give sweets

17. What should we remember when we think of Israfil? (1 mark)
   A. We must fear dogs
   B. The Day of Judgement is true
   C. Rain will stop
   D. Prayer is not needed

18. Which of these is NOT an angel duty? (1 mark)
   A. Bringing revelation by Allah's order
   B. Taking souls by permission
   C. Making rain by their own power
   D. Recording deeds

19. What is honesty? (1 mark)
   A. Hiding things
   B. Telling lies
   C. Boasting
   D. Not cheating or stealing and keeping trust

20. Which prophet's story shows a person who refused wrongdoing and feared Allah? (1 mark)
   A. Hud
   B. Nuh
   C. Yusuf
   D. Ilyas

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Explain what a person should do if they do not like a food served to them. (3 marks)

22. Describe how the Prophet (S.A.W.) solved the dispute over placing the Black Stone. (3 marks)

23. Explain why Muslims should not waste food and give two ways of avoiding waste. (4 marks)

24. Explain how Ibrahim and Ismail (A.S.) showed obedience to Allah. (4 marks)

25. Explain the meaning of the hadith "I have been sent for the purpose of perfecting good morals". (3 marks)

26. Write the six pillars of Iman and put a mark next to the one studied in this lesson. (4 marks)

27. Match each surah with one lesson: Al-Fatiha, Al-Kafirun, An-Nasr and Al-Ikhlas. (4 marks)

28. Describe what the Prophet (S.A.W.) did every night before sleeping with Al-Ikhlas, Al-Falaq and An-Naas. (3 marks)

29. Name the first and the last prophet. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #4 (TERM 1) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — An-Nasr
   An-Nasr speaks of victory and tells us to praise Allah and ask forgiveness.

2. D — Al-Falaq and An-Naas
   Both begin with "Qul a'udhu", meaning "Say: I seek refuge".

3. A — Al-Kafirun
   This is the last verse of Al-Kafirun.

4. D — The Opening
   Al-Fatiha means "The Opening" because it opens the Qur'an.

5. C — An-Nasr
   An-Nasr is 110, Al-Masad 111 and Al-Kafirun 109.

6. B — His uncle Abu Talib
   Abu Talib cared for him as a young boy.

7. C — Good prayer should go with good manners
   The Prophet was sent to perfect good morals as well.

8. A — Eat from your own side of the dish
   The hadith teaches eating from what is in front of you.

9. C — Serve them first and respect them
   Hospitality is a Muslim value.

10. D — Brushing twice a day
   Regular brushing prevents cavities.

11. D — Purifying the mouth and pleasing Allah
   The hadith says it purifies the mouth and pleases Allah.

12. A — Teamwork
   Working together builds teamwork.

13. C — Swimming, archery and horse riding
   The hadith says to teach children these skills.

14. B — Al-Malik
   Everything belongs to the true King.

15. B — The Source of Peace
   As-Salam is free of all faults and gives peace.

16. B — Our words and actions are recorded
   We try to speak and do good.

17. B — The Day of Judgement is true
   The Trumpet will be blown by Allah's command.

18. C — Making rain by their own power
   Angels act only by Allah's command.

19. D — Not cheating or stealing and keeping trust
   Honest people are trusted.

20. C — Yusuf
   Yusuf refused temptation.

SECTION B
----
21. (3 marks)
   Answer: Leave it quietly and politely without criticising, as the Prophet did, and thank the person.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for not criticising, 1 mark for quietness or politeness, 1 mark for thanks.

22. (3 marks)
   Answer: He placed the stone on a cloak and asked a leader from each tribe to hold an edge and lift it together, then he set it in place.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the cloak, 1 mark for leaders lifting together, 1 mark for setting it in place.

23. (4 marks)
   Answer: Allah does not love the wasteful. Take only what you can finish, and share leftovers while fresh.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for reason, 1 mark for Qur'an 7:31 or Allah's dislike, 2 marks for two ways.

24. (4 marks)
   Answer: Ibrahim was told in a dream to sacrifice his son, Ismail said to do as commanded and that he would be patient, and both were ready. Allah replaced Ismail with a ram.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the command, 1 mark for Ismail's reply, 1 mark for readiness, 1 mark for the ram.

25. (3 marks)
   Answer: The Prophet's mission included completing and perfecting good character. Good manners are part of the faith and must be practised every day.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for perfecting good morals, 1 mark for part of faith, 1 mark for daily practice.

26. (4 marks)
   Answer: Belief in Allah, angels, books, messengers, the Last Day and destiny. Angels are the one studied.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for every two pillars named, 1 mark for identifying angels.

27. (4 marks)
   Answer: Al-Fatiha: praise Allah and ask for guidance; Al-Kafirun: stay firm in faith; An-Nasr: thank Allah when you succeed; Al-Ikhlas: Allah is One.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct pair.

28. (3 marks)
   Answer: He joined his hands, blew into them, recited the three surahs and wiped his body with his hands.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for blowing into the hands, 1 mark for the three surahs, 1 mark for wiping the body.

29. (2 marks)
   Answer: Adam was the first and Muhammad (S.A.W.) was the last.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.
